title: GET /runner/v1/ops: the query parameters
description: PROTOCOL.md §5.4. A query string carries text: a parameter written as a decimal integer is read as that integer before it is checked, and any other value stays a string, which fails `type`. Parameters that fail this schema are 400 invalid_request. Other parameters are ignored.

after.description: Default 0. The highest `sequence` the runner has taken.

wait.description: Default 25, in seconds. A value above 25 is treated as 25; 0 answers at once.
